description:
We are a multidisciplinary squad of four engineers operating at the intersection of Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, and Cybersecurity. Our background covers intelligent systems, advanced analytics, predictive modeling, and resilient digital infrastructure.

Our Mission: Space-grade solutions shouldn't just be smart—they must be reliable, interpretable, and secure by design. We combine AI with strict data integrity to build end-to-end solutions for real NASA challenges.
